test_ImagePooler_basic: test the ImagePooler class with resize_short and resize_max parameters to pool image regions
test_ImagePooler_scale_box: test the ImagePooler class with box_scale_factor to scale cropped bounding boxes
test_ImagePooler_crop_only: test the ImagePooler class with box_scale_factor 1.0 to crop bounding boxes without scaling
test_ImagePooler_crop_and_scale: test the ImagePooler class with box_scale_factor 1.2 to crop and scale bounding boxes
test_ImagePooler_crop_scale_resize: test the ImagePooler class with resize_shortest, resize_short, resize_max, and box_scale_factor together
